description: This file defines a set of React components for a UI sheet (drawer) using Radix UI primitives, with styling and behavior for overlay, content, header, footer, title, description, and close actions.

methods.name: Sheet
methods.description: Main component that renders the root of the sheet using Radix UI's Root component.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers the opening of the sheet.

methods.name: SheetClose
methods.description: Component that closes the sheet when activated.

methods.name: SheetPortal
methods.description: Component that renders sheet content in a portal.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component that appears behind the sheet, with styling for open/closed states.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Component that contains the main content of the sheet, with side options for positioning.

methods.name: SheetHeader
methods.description: Component for the sheet's header section.

methods.name: SheetFooter
methods.description: Component for the sheet's footer section.
